I am an Applied Mathematics and Statistics graduate from Khalifa University with two years across data science, data engineering, analytics, and full stack development. At Saal.ai I was the primary developer of a procurement audit platform that flags exceptions in ERP data. Since April 2026 I have freelanced for Join Future, building features for their salon management SaaS, and on my own I shipped Stmnt, an iOS app on the App Store.

The work I want pairs modelling with the engineering that makes a model usable.
